status: Frozen local exploratory extension, defined after inspecting the original outcomes; not a preregistration or independent replication cohort.
cohort: Same fixed 4000/500/1000 patient splits; no exclusions or fresh test tuning.
tangent_definition: Project SIGNED gradient or signed path-average gradient before abs and, where appropriate, before input multiplication. Never project absolute or input-weighted maps directly.
matched_comparator: Without-replacement random lead-window matches among five nearest log-energy candidates to each selected cell, then exactly scale raw delta L2 to guided raw dose. Apply raw and projected energy-matched operators at the same guided dose. Supply matching error and pre-rescale amplitude/dose ratios.
geometry_mechanism: Decompose raw delta into P delta and (I-P) delta. Measure normal energy fraction and evaluate P delta WITHOUT renormalization in the original three-method audit; do not infer model insensitivity from energy fraction alone.
secondary_replacement: Within each selected 500-ms window replace by that lead-window's mean, original three methods plus tangent IG, uniform comparator; same raw/energy normalization; no target-matched estimand asserted.

positive_control.wrapper: logit_lambda(x) = logit_base(Px) + lambda * dot(w, (I-P)x); fixed unit normal template w supported on deterministic early-time limb windows
positive_control.methods: Original saliency/input-gradient/IG, recomputed per wrapper; also original frozen masks evaluated for all wrappers to isolate evaluator from attribution changes.
positive_control.validation_selection: Freeze a lambda based only on validation: first grid level reversing a non-tied method pair under independent evaluation relative to lambda 0. If none succeeds report control failure; no expansion based on test.
positive_control.guarantees: On-subspace logits identical mathematically; feasible perturbation responses for FIXED masks invariant. Recomputed unprojected attribution masks need not be invariant even with a feasible evaluator; report them separately.

statistics: Paired patient bootstrap with seeds averaged within each architecture; original six absolute intervals retained historically. Relative original ratios use ratio of cohort mean advantages, paired resampling numerator and denominator. Extension intervals descriptive 95%, no confirmatory equivalence declaration and no architecture/seed population generalization.
ranking_focus: Explicit input-gradient vs IG and tangent-IG comparisons, margins/intervals, unresolved order; do not count saliency separation as evidence of power for near ties.
limitations_to_retain: two CNN architectures do not cover all model families
